dependencies.basis: Provincial GDP (PDRB) is compiled simultaneously with national GDP under the same 2008 SNA framework and 2010 base year to ensure consistency. Evidence: "Bantuan teknis dan Support ABS terkait Neraca Nasional meliputi kegiatan training dan workshop dalam penyusunan Supply and Use Table (SUT) dan Full Sequence of Accounts (FSA) dalam rangka implementasi SNA 2008 yang ditargetkan akan dirilis perdana pada 2014. ... sebagai benchmark dalam penyusunan PDB/PDRB tahun dasar 2010"
dependencies.evidence_quote: sebagai benchmark dalam penyusunan PDB/PDRB tahun dasar 2010

dependencies.basis: Bank Indonesia compiles Balance of Payments and International Investment Position statistics according to the concepts, definitions, and classifications of BPM6. Evidence: "Generally, BOP statistics are compiled based on the Balance of Payments and International Investment Position Manual, 6th Edition (BPM6), which includes transactions between residents and non-residents. ... Fundamentally, BOP Statistics are compiled based on the concepts and definitions contained in BPM6."
dependencies.evidence_quote: Indonesia’s balance of payments statistics generally follow the concepts and definitions set out in the sixth edition of the IMF’s Balance of Payments and International Investment Position Manual (BPM6).

dependencies.basis: Susenas household expenditure data serve as an alternative or supporting source for updating CPI expenditure weights and consumption patterns (alongside the primary HBS). Evidence: "In Statistics Indonesia, one of the alternative data sources that portrays household expenditure is National Socio-Economic Survey (SUSENAS). ... The grouping of goods and services captured in the consumption module Susenas is also guided by the 2018 COICOP, the same as was done for the HBS and CPS. Therefore, this data can be used as an alternative approach to annual CPI reweighting."
dependencies.evidence_quote: In Statistics Indonesia, one of the alternative data sources that portrays household expenditure is National Socio-Economic Survey (SUSENAS).

dependencies.basis: Household final consumption expenditure (PK-RT) estimates in the national accounts are based on per-capita consumption expenditure data from Susenas, grouped by COICOP divisions. Evidence: "Estimasi PK-RT untuk harga berlaku didasarkan pada data pengeluaran konsumsi per kapita hasil Survei Sosial Ekonomi Nasional (Susenas). Angka yang dihasilkan kemudian dikelompokkan ke dalam 12 divisi COICOP."
dependencies.evidence_quote: A household budget survey, the National Economic Social Survey (NESS), collects consumption expenditures every years.

dependencies.basis: Official poverty incidence and related indicators are calculated from household expenditure data collected in the National Socio-Economic Survey (Susenas). Evidence: "The data sources used in this publication are data from the March 2022 National Socio-Economic Survey (Susenas)."
dependencies.evidence_quote: The data sources used in this publication are data from the March 2022 National Socio-Economic Survey (Susenas).

dependencies.basis: Indonesia Foreign Trade Statistics (Exports) classify commodities according to the Harmonized System (HS) for international comparability, using the Indonesian Customs Tariff Book version of HS. Evidence: "This publication uses the Harmonized Systems (HS) 2024 classification for international comparability consideration. The data presented here is in units of net weight (kilograms) and FOB value (US dollars) broken down by commodity and country of destination."
dependencies.evidence_quote: This publication uses the Harmonized Systems (HS) 2024 classification for international comparability consideration.

dependencies.basis: Indonesia Foreign Trade Statistics (Imports) likewise classify commodities using the Harmonized System (HS). Evidence: "Indonesia compiles external trade statistics according to the Harmonised Commodity and Coding System (HS). The Harmonised System (HS) is a high-level international nomenclature owned by the World Customs Organisation (WCO), comprising of 6 digits and used by the majority of trading nations."
dependencies.evidence_quote: Systems that are used to classify exports and imports data are the Harmonized System (HS).

dependencies.basis: Primary source data for export statistics are the Goods Export Declaration (PEB) documents and related records supplied by the Directorate General of Customs and Excise (customs authorities). Evidence: "The primary source of export originates from the Directorate General of Customs and Excise in the form of a Goods Export Declaration (PEB) document, PT. Pos Indonesia, border records of other agencies, and exports enumeration in the sea border area."
dependencies.evidence_quote: The primary source of export originates from the Directorate General of Customs and Excise in the form of a Goods Export Declaration (PEB) document, PT. Pos Indonesia, border records of other agencies, and exports enumeration in the sea border area.

dependencies.basis: Primary source data for import statistics are customs declaration documents supplied by Customs Authorities under the institutional arrangement with BPS. Evidence: "There are three sources for external trade data such as the customs declarations provided by Customs Authorities, post dispatch provided by PT Posindo, and cross sea border trade survey. Customs declaration data provided monthly by Customs Authorities based on MOU letter between BPS, Customs Office, and Central Bank."
dependencies.evidence_quote: Data on exports and imports are mainly based on administrative records, in the form of customs declaration documents. Documents from customs are delivered to BPS every month through a secured joint portal web.

dependencies.basis: Informal employment proportion statistics are derived from Sakernas labour-force survey data (including expanded modules for informal identification). Evidence: "For the time being, statistics on the informal economy in Indonesia are based on the regular national labour force survey (Sakernas) which only lies on the employment status and occupation ... Phase 1, the Expanded LFS (Sakernas), contains additional questions that can be classified into three categories namely: 1) informal employment module"
dependencies.evidence_quote: For the time being, statistics on the informal economy in Indonesia are based on the regular national labour force survey (Sakernas) which only lies on the employment status and occupation
